description: This header defines functions and classes for various random distributions used with the Abseil C++ library, including uniform, Bernoulli, Beta, Exponential, Gaussian, LogUniform, Poisson, and Zipf distributions.

methods.name: Uniform
methods.description: Generates a uniformly distributed random value of type R within specified bounds, with support for different interval types and overloads for different input types.

methods.name: Bernoulli
methods.description: Generates a boolean value with probability p of being true.

methods.name: Beta
methods.description: Generates a floating-point value from a Beta distribution with parameters alpha and beta.

methods.name: Exponential
methods.description: Generates a floating-point value from an Exponential distribution with rate lambda.

methods.name: Gaussian
methods.description: Generates a floating-point value from a Gaussian (normal) distribution with specified mean and standard deviation.

methods.name: LogUniform
methods.description: Generates an integer value where the logarithm (base) of the value is uniformly distributed.

methods.name: Poisson
methods.description: Generates an integer value from a Poisson distribution with a specified mean.

methods.name: Zipf
methods.description: Generates an integer value from a Zipf distribution with parameters hi, q, v.
